params.name: steps
params.interactions: fewer steps on dev degrade quality; schnell above ~4 brings no measured benefit; Turbo-Alpha wants exactly 8

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: classifier-free guidance; FLUX.1 is guidance-distilled and has no negative prompt, so cfg stays 1.0 and the negative is ConditioningZeroOut (or an empty string)
params.interactions: 'Flux dev and schnell do not have any negative prompt so CFG should be set to 1.0' (template note); SD-style cfg 7+ gives 'a grey or overexposed image'; cfg > 1 doubles compute

params.name: guidance
params.meaning: the distilled guidance embedding the dev models were trained on (guidance_embed True); replaces CFG. Without a FluxGuidance node ComfyUI uses the model default 3.5
params.interactions: community realism advice 2.0-3.5, 'anything above 5 looks deep-fried' (single-source); Kontext: 'Raising it hard tends to produce over-baked edits rather than better adherence'

params.name: max_shift / base_shift
params.meaning: resolution-dependent timestep shift: shift = (w*h/256)*mm + b with mm = (max_shift-base_shift)/(4096-256); base_shift at 256 latent tokens, max_shift at 4096 (1024x1024)

defaults.without the node: fixed shift 1.15 (dev family); schnell config shift 1.0

params.interactions: optional; template note: bypass it to disable resolution adaptation

params.name: denoise
params.meaning: 1.0 in every template including Kontext (full re-noise; the reference conditions via ReferenceLatent — the encoded input as latent_image only fixes the output size)

params.name: width / height
params.meaning: EmptySD3LatentImage: 16-channel latent at /8, step 16; ModelSamplingFlux step 8

defaults.Kontext: set by FluxKontextImageScale from the input

params.interactions: FLUX trained to ~1 MP (community); BFL TRT note: 'height and width have to be within 768 and 1344'; Kontext preferred resolutions: 672x1568, 688x1504, 720x1456, 752x1392, 800x1328, 832x1248, 880x1184, 944x1104, 1024x1024 and their transposes

params.name: Kontext references
params.meaning: one reference per ReferenceLatent (chain to append); or stitch two images into one; reference_latents_method 'offset' is the FLUX.1 default, 'index' gives each reference its own index channel
params.interactions: each reference adds tokens -> VRAM; community uses 2-4; no official maximum for Kontext dev in ComfyUI (BFL API: up to 10); FluxKontextMultiReferenceLatentMethod needs ComfyUI >= 0.3.51

params.name: noise_mask
params.meaning: 'Add a noise mask to the latent so sampling will only happen within the mask. Might improve results or completely break things depending on the model.'
params.interactions: with DifferentialDiffusion strength 1 on the model

params.name: padding / feathering
params.meaning: canvas added per side (step 8) and the soft edge of the generated mask
params.interactions: community: grow + blur the mask (GrowMask, VAEEncodeForInpaint.grow_mask_by ~64) against seams

params.name: Canny thresholds
params.interactions: BFL diffusers sample uses CannyDetector 50/200 at 1024

params.name: Redux strength
params.meaning: weight of the reference image's style; multiply or attn_bias
params.interactions: chain StyleModelApply nodes to mix images

params.name: weight_dtype
params.meaning: default | fp8_e4m3fn | fp8_e4m3fn_fast | fp8_e5m2: load the bf16 file as fp8 to halve memory 'but might reduce quality a tiny bit'
params.interactions: fp8 saves VRAM on any card but speeds up only Ada (40-series) and newer; fp8_e4m3fn_fast only helps on Ada+

params.name: device
params.meaning: default | cpu: keep the 9.8 GB T5 off the GPU
params.interactions: the OOM fix for t5xxl_fp16 on small cards, with the fp8 T5 files

rules.message: FLUX.1 text encoding is DualCLIPLoader with type 'flux' (clip_l + t5xxl); any other type mis-encodes the prompt
one DualCLIPLoader slot must be clip_l.safetensors ('Using t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors in both CLIP slots of DualClipLoader' is a listed error); slot order does not matter
the other DualCLIPLoader slot must be a t5xxl file: t5xxl_fp16 (>32 GB RAM), t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn or t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled (low VRAM)

FLUX.1 decodes with ae.safetensors (16-channel, /8). An SDXL/SD1.5 VAE gives 'expected input[1, 16, 128, 128] to have 4 channels, but got 16 channels' -> grey/washed-out or an error; the FLUX.2 ae.safetensors is 128-channel and also wrong
FLUX.1 is guidance-distilled: 'Flux dev and schnell do not have any negative prompt so CFG should be set to 1.0'; SD-style cfg 7+ gives a grey or overexposed image; steer with FluxGuidance instead
same as cfg-is-1-unet for the fp8 all-in-one checkpoints: 'Make sure you set CFG to 1.0 when using it'

FLUX.1's latent is 16-channel: text-to-image starts from EmptySD3LatentImage; edits start from the input image (VAEEncode), Canny/Depth from InstructPixToPixConditioning, Fill from InpaintModelConditioning. EmptyLatentImage (4-channel SD) or EmptyFlux2LatentImage (128-channel) are the wrong shape
EmptySD3LatentImage takes width/height in multiples of 16
ModelSamplingFlux width/height step 8; keep them equal to the latent size so the resolution-dependent shift is computed for the image actually sampled
schnell is 'latent adversarial diffusion distillation ... high-quality images in only 1 to 4 steps'; more steps bring no benefit measured in the sources and cost time
FluxGuidance has no effect on schnell (guidance_embed False in the FluxSchnell config): tune steps/seed/prompt instead
dev-trained LoRAs on schnell: 'LoRAs trained on dev seem to not work as well on schnell' (step distillation breaks down); use dev or Krea
the Depth/Canny LoRAs 'require the base FLUX.1 [dev] model' (BFL); not for Fill, Kontext or schnell
FLUX.1-Turbo-Alpha is an '8-step distilled lora for FLUX.1-dev model', 'FLUX.1-dev only'
the Turbo-Alpha card recommends 8 steps (guidance 3.5, LoRA scale 1)
FLUX.1 Fill is the 96-in-channel model (16 latent + 64 masked image + 16 mask): it needs InpaintModelConditioning (pixels + mask); a plain EmptySD3LatentImage gives garbage
both Fill templates patch the model with DifferentialDiffusion (strength 1: per-pixel denoise strength from the mask) for soft mask edges
Fill was released with guidance 30 (BFL card and both templates); the T2I default 3.5 is not what this model was trained for
the outpaint template sets InpaintModelConditioning.noise_mask = false (inpaint sets true)
the Canny/Depth models take the control image through InstructPixToPixConditioning (concat conditioning); a plain latent gives garbage
the Depth/Canny LoRAs need InstructPixToPixConditioning with the control image as pixels, exactly as the template
Canny conditioning runs at guidance 30 (template and BFL card); Depth at 10
Kontext is an editing model: the input image is VAE-encoded and attached with ReferenceLatent; without it Kontext is not a from-scratch T2I replacement
pass references through FluxKontextImageScale: 'oversized inputs may lead to degraded model output quality or issues such as multiple subjects appearing in the output'
Kontext ships at guidance 2.5 (BFL --guidance 2.5, template); 'Raising it hard tends to produce over-baked edits rather than better adherence'
Redux needs the SigLIP vision encoder (sigclip_vision_patch14_384.safetensors via CLIPVisionLoader -> CLIPVisionEncode -> StyleModelApply)
NVFP4 files need Blackwell (RTX 50 / sm120) FP4 tensor cores; on 40-series and older they are slow or fail to load (ComfyUI issue #11864) — use fp8_scaled there

fp8 weights save VRAM on any card but are only faster on Ada (RTX 40) and newer; Ampere (RTX 30) has no FP8 tensor cores and upcasts — GGUF Q8_0 is the usual alternative there. Answer: fine on an Ada/Blackwell box
the recipe's template minComfyUIVersion (0.0.4 / 0.3.42) is below the pinned 0.35.0 image for every FLUX.1 recipe; FluxKontextMultiReferenceLatentMethod needs 0.3.51
FLUX.1 renders what a negation names ('no', 'without') and has no working negative at cfg 1 — describe what IS there

prompting.negative_gloss: none: at cfg 1.0 the negative is ignored ('Thanks to Flux's excellent prompt following capability, we don't need any negative prompts'); the graphs feed ConditioningZeroOut or an empty string

positive.line: BFL: 'Prompt following is heavily influenced by the prompting-style' — plain natural language, no SD tag soups

Structure (BFL 'Building a Good Prompt'): [SUBJECT], [LOCATION], [STYLE], [CAMERA SETTINGS], [LIGHTING], [COLORS], [EFFECT], [ADDITIONAL ELEMENTS]; 'Start short. Add only what changes the image.'; 'Specific detail helps. Filler hurts.'; short 10-30 words, medium 30-80, long 80-300+
No negation: 'writing a person without glasses causes the model to focus on glasses'. Replace: 'no people' -> 'empty', 'deserted', 'solitary'; 'no text' -> 'clean surfaces', 'unmarked', 'blank'
T5 budget: 512 tokens (~350 English words), the rest is truncated; '40-50 words is the sweet spot'

CLIPTextEncodeFlux (schnell full template): clip_l 'Suitable for concise keyword descriptions, such as style or theme', t5xxl 'Suitable for detailed natural language descriptions'; CLIPTextEncode sends one text to both

Kontext: 'Change the car color to red'; name the style ('Transform to Bauhaus art style'); preserve explicitly ('while maintaining the same facial features, hairstyle, and expression'); text edits in quotes ('Replace joy with BFL'); verbs 'change'/'replace' rather than 'transform'; step-by-step edits

Kontext templates: 'Change [object] to [new state], keep [content to preserve] unchanged'; 'Change the background to [new background], keep the subject in the exact same position and pose'; 'Replace [original text] with [new text], maintain the same font style'
Kontext: English prompts only (docs.comfy.org); iterative edits with minimal drift ('Remove the object from her face' -> 'She is now taking a selfie in the streets of Freiburg' -> 'It's now snowing')
Redux: 'Even without a prompt, this model can still apply the image styles from the reference images'

prompting.structure: subject, location, style, camera, lighting, colors, effect; 30-80 words; Kontext: 'Change X to Y, keep Z unchanged'

hurts.line: negation words ('no', 'without') — the model renders the thing

Kontext: vague verbs ('transform', 'make it a sketch'), omitting what must stay ('Kontext keeps only what you name'), non-English prompts, 'Put him on a beach' instead of 'Change the background to a beach while keeping the person in the exact same position, scale, and pose'
SD-style tag soups, weights and negative prompts: 'quality rarely improves with them' (single-source)

pitfalls.symptom: OOM or very slow load with t5xxl_fp16.safetensors
pitfalls.fix: t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors (4.9 GB) or t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled; fp16 only with >32 GB RAM; DualCLIPLoader.device = cpu; GGUF T5 via DualCLIPLoaderGGUF

pitfalls.symptom: grey / washed-out / overexposed image, or 'expected input[1, 16, 128, 128] to have 4 channels, but got 16 channels'
pitfalls.cause: wrong VAE (SDXL/SD1.5/taesd on the 16-channel FLUX latent) or cfg left at SD values (7+)
pitfalls.fix: VAELoader ae.safetensors; cfg 1.0; strength via FluxGuidance

pitfalls.symptom: black images with some fp8 models / LoRA + fp8
pitfalls.cause: fp8 handling bug on certain checkpoints (fixed in ComfyUI v0.3.41, 2025-06-17)
pitfalls.fix: update ComfyUI (the 0.35.0 image is past the fix); community: dev instead of schnell for some LoRAs
FluxGuidance 2-3.5 ('anything above 5 looks deep-fried'); Krea dev was trained against 'oversaturated textures' and the 'AI look'

pitfalls.symptom: Kontext repaints the whole image / changes identity or composition
pitfalls.cause: under-specified prompt; too-large or odd-sized input; guidance pushed too high
pitfalls.fix: 'name what stays, not just what changes'; keep FluxKontextImageScale; guidance ~2-2.5; edit in steps

pitfalls.symptom: Fill: visible seams / color shift at the mask border
pitfalls.cause: hard mask edge; no noise mask; 'Possible color shifts in unfilled areas' (BFL card limitation)
pitfalls.fix: grow + blur the mask (GrowMask / VAEEncodeForInpaint.grow_mask_by 64 then lower), feathering on ImagePadForOutpaint (template 24), keep DifferentialDiffusion, noise_mask true for inpaint / false for outpaint, composite the original back outside the mask

pitfalls.symptom: LoRA trained on dev behaves badly on schnell
pitfalls.cause: schnell is step-distilled: 'every step you train breaks down the compression more and more'
pitfalls.fix: use dev (or Krea) for dev LoRAs; for schnell training use ostris/FLUX.1-schnell-training-adapter

pitfalls.symptom: FluxGuidance has no visible effect on schnell
pitfalls.cause: guidance_embed False in the FluxSchnell config
pitfalls.fix: steps/seed/prompt; guidance only matters for the dev family

pitfalls.symptom: fp8 is not faster on RTX 30-series / earlier
pitfalls.cause: Ampere has no native FP8 tensor cores (Ada does); ComfyUI upcasts
pitfalls.fix: expect VRAM savings but no speedup; fp8_e4m3fn_fast only helps on Ada+; GGUF Q8_0 is the usual alternative

pitfalls.cause: NVFP4 needs Blackwell (RTX 50 / sm120) FP4 tensor cores
pitfalls.fix: fp8_scaled on 40-series, NVFP4 only on RTX 50 (issue #11864 for 5090 loading failures)

pitfalls.cause: BFL repos require accepting the license
pitfalls.fix: accept on each repo (dev, Fill, Canny, Depth, Kontext, Krea, Redux) or use the Comfy-Org mirrors (not gated)

pitfalls.cause: both slots set to T5, or type not flux
pitfalls.fix: one slot clip_l.safetensors, one t5xxl_*.safetensors, type flux

pitfalls.symptom: Fill/Canny/Depth produce garbage with a plain EmptySD3LatentImage
pitfalls.cause: these models need concat conditioning (Fill in_channels 96; control image for Canny/Depth)
pitfalls.fix: InpaintModelConditioning (Fill) / InstructPixToPixConditioning (Canny, Depth) exactly as the templates

pitfalls.symptom: macOS: 'Trying to convert Float8_e4m3fn to the MPS backend'
pitfalls.fix: bf16 files / GGUF on Apple silicon

pitfalls.symptom: the depth-LoRA template's flux1-dev-fp8.safetensors via UNETLoader confuses (same filename as the all-in-one checkpoint)
pitfalls.cause: the template points the 17 GB checkpoint at diffusion_models; ComfyUI can load a checkpoint's UNET through UNETLoader
pitfalls.fix: the recipes here load flux1-dev.safetensors instead (or Kijai's fp8 UNET-only file); keep the all-in-one in checkpoints for the CheckpointLoaderSimple recipes

pitfalls.symptom: docs and template disagree (docs.comfy.org has the 'Dev' and 'Dev fp8' headings swapped relative to the JSON; flux_dev_checkpoint_example carries the UNETLoader graph)
pitfalls.fix: the template JSON is newer and wins; t2i-dev-fp8 here follows the documented CheckpointLoaderSimple path explicitly
